current_state_summary: Puteri Delima Satu (IMO 9211872) is confirmed converted to and operating as an LNG Floating Storage Unit (FSU), not trading as a conventional LNG carrier. MISC and Pengerang LNG (Two) Sdn Bhd (a PETRONAS Gas Berhad subsidiary) signed a binding heads of agreement in Oct 2023 to convert the vessel (which had completed its long-term carrier charter and gone into lay-up) into a dedicated FSU for the PETRONAS LNG Regasification Terminal Pengerang (RGTP), Johor, under a 20-year contract, targeting Q2 2025 commercial start. MISC's own FY2025 Integrated Annual Report confirms the conversion was completed and the FSU was delivered and safely commissioned at Pengerang RGTP (>500,000 man-hours, zero Lost Time Injury). The backend's current Vessel type = 'conventional' for row 61 is therefore stale and should be reviewed/updated (as a data-fill proposal, not edited directly per repo rules) to reflect FSU status and Pengerang RGTP deployment. This is a separate, younger vessel from the older 'Puteri Delima' (IMO 9030814, built 1995), which the same MISC annual report lists as disposed of alongside 'Puteri Nilam' -- confirming no conflation between the two ships.
